Delhi Police Protest: ACP Manasvi Vashishtha was suspended after he joined a protest staged by the Delhi police personnel outside the Delhi police headquarter. But after what was called a 'successful dialogue' ACP Vashishtha was served a notice of suspension. The Indian Express' Srirupa Goswami speaks to suspended ACP Manasvi Vashishtha.
